name: Santosh Email
description: Your Gmail, Outlook or any email: read, threads, sort, reply (rich markdown), forward, attachments (incl. Drive files), labels, Gmail drafts, follow-ups, undo send, scheduled and bulk mail. New-mail watcher with rules, snooze and quiet hours. Gmail settings: vacation auto-reply, signature pushed into Gmail, send-as aliases, auto-forward. Asks before sending, deleting or bulk mail
notes: Driven by the email_* tools; this pack holds the delete, bulk-mail, label-delete, Gmail-draft-delete, vacation, signature-push and auto-forward confirm cards
